title: Members are offered a comment-reaction control that answers 400: grant reactions to every member, or withhold the control
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRsWwTRkuRCyQwvpAG

Split out of #33343 (its item 2 landed in PR #33499; this is the question that report 6885790261 left open). Filed so #33343 can close.

## 维护者速读

- 问题:普通成员在记录页的评论上能看到“表情回应”按钮,一点就报错(400)。原因是成员没有回应对象(sys_comment_reaction)的权限,页面退回到一个已经废弃的旧字段去写。
- 选项:A 给每个成员默认开回应权限(读+新建,不能删,约 1 行);B 保持按应用授权,但让控制台在无权时隐藏按钮(改动大,需要新的部署信号);C 维持现状。
- 开发推荐 A:回应对象本身就是按“只有默认权限的成员也能回应”来写的。这会放宽成员的读权限,需要您裁决;发卡前席位会先做独立评审。

## Measured (showcase, origin/main ba35dfd7, stock member)

`PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_comment/ID {reactions}` answers 400 INVALID_FIELD ("Unknown field reactions on object sys_comment"), and `POST /api/v1/data/sys_comment_reaction` answers 403. The record page takes the column store for a caller refused sys_comment_reaction, and that store offers the reaction control under `feedReactionColumn` = update on sys_comment, which member_default grants. So the click is the 400.

## Options (report 6885790261, decisions_needed[0])

- **A**: add a member_default line for sys_comment_reaction (allowRead + allowCreate, no delete), beside the ruling-6633054352 sys_comment line. Rows stay gated by the reaction read gate (readable exactly when the comment is). The page then takes the records store. This widens member reads, so it needs a maintainer ruling. About 1 line plus a dogfood pin.
- **B**: keep reactions app-granted and have the console withhold the column-store control from a refused caller. This needs a deployment signal the console lacks today. Larger: console plus contract.
- **C**: keep today's behaviour.

## Reader

`domain:server` area A2 (permissions), with a ui follow-up under B. needs-user-decision: the seat runs an independent review before the question goes to the maintainer.

## Dedupe

Words: `reaction column store member`, `sys_comment.reactions INVALID_FIELD`, `feedReactionColumn`, `member reactions grant`. Only #33343 carries them.
